At tag v2.1.2 (6e47d8c3e91a83bfdae10f97b740a22d247fb847), PUT /user/{id} is registered with LoggedIn()+UserIdMatch (internal/app/api/v0/handlers/endpoint_users.go), so any authenticated user may update their own record. handleUpdatePut JSON-decodes model.User; models_user.go exposes json:"IsAdmin" and NewDomainUser copies src.IsAdmin into domain.User. user_manager.UpdateUser allows currentUser.Id == new.Identifier even when not admin, then CopyCalculatedAttributes (internal/domain/user.go) restores only BaseModel and LinkedPeerCount before SaveUser, so client-controlled IsAdmin is persisted. Reauthentication then loads admin from the database.
